messages:
jordan: hey — quick question for the group: where should I create a new Notion page for the Payments team? do we have a specific parent or space for team docs? :wave:
maria: hey jordan — welcome! :wave: Payments should live under Product > Teams > Payments in Notion (so Product space, not the company handbook). we keep team-run playbooks there so eng/product can edit.
alex: fwiw if you can’t see Product > Teams, that usually means you don’t have edit rights for the Product space.
jordan: I only see the top-level product index, not the Teams list. what’s the quickest path to get edit access?
maria: easiest is to ping devex (or me) with the page link and we’ll grant edit rights. if you haven’t created the page at all, create a draft in your personal workspace and then request we move/duplicate it under Product > Teams.
sam: steps I follow: 1) in Notion, open Product > Teams parent page, click the + to add a subpage OR duplicate my local draft and move it. 2) set the page property Team = Payments and Visibility = Team. 
alex: quick copy tip — open your draft, click the ••• menu top-right -> Duplicate. then drag the duplicate into Product > Teams in the sidebar. if you prefer we can move it for you after you share the draft link.
devex-bot: reminder: use the internal access request form for bulk perms (/request-access) if you need >3 pages changed or a role change. link: https://redwood-internal.company/ops/access-requests
maria: also, use the Team Page template (Product > Templates > Team Page) — it has the standard sections (overview, oncall, runbook, onboarding checklist). if you don’t see Templates, I can copy it into your draft.
jordan: where is the template located exactly? I can’t find Product > Templates.
maria: Product space -> Templates section. if invisible: share your Notion email and I’ll add a view. or paste your draft link here and I’ll duplicate into the right spot.
ajex: (typo) sorry — alex here. if you want me to do the first move I can. just drop the draft link.
jordan: cool — dropping draft now: https://notion.so/d/abc123 (this is personal draft).
maria: got it. I’ll duplicate into Product > Teams > Payments and set permissions so Payments joiners have edit by default. will post back when done.
jordan: awesome, thanks! :white_check_mark:
maria: done — moved and set Team property. product/devex should all be able to edit. I also copied the Team Page template sections. @alex @sam if you want to tidy the runbook sections please do.
alex: thanks — will add deployment runbook notes later today.
jordan: much appreciated everyone. one more Q: if we later want to make a public (company-facing) version of the page, what's the process?
maria: create a copy, change Visibility = Company, and run the doc review checklist (Product > Processes > Doc Reviews). for any external/public pages ping marketing for an OK.
jordan: perfect, will follow that. thanks again!
